candidate.blueprint_locator: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — implement and evaluate infection-prevention practices and safety measures that reduce transmission and protect clients and health care personnel.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — hand-hygiene adherence monitoring and feedback
candidate.educational_objective: Use infection-prevention audit data to identify adherence gaps, provide prompt and regular feedback, and support corrective improvement rather than treating measurement as an end in itself.

options.A: Use the results only to identify individual staff for discipline without unit-level improvement feedback.
options.B: Replace infection-prevention education with audit scores because measurement alone changes practice.
options.C: Use the results to identify adherence gaps and provide regular feedback that supports improvement.
options.D: Collect compliance data for reporting purposes without discussing findings or changing practice.

candidate.rationale: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices identify performance monitoring and feedback as a core practice: facilities should monitor adherence to infection-prevention practices, provide prompt and regular feedback on adherence and related outcomes to healthcare personnel and leadership, and act on surveillance data. Therefore C is correct. A limits monitoring to punishment rather than improvement, B incorrectly substitutes measurement for required education and training, and D disconnects collected data from feedback and corrective action.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Infection-prevention performance monitoring should identify adherence gaps, be paired with prompt and regular feedback, and inform improvement actions; it does not replace education or exist only for reporting or discipline.
candidate.source_document_title: CDC's Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices for Safe Healthcare Delivery in All Settings
candidate.source_locator: Core Practices Table > 4. Performance Monitoring and Feedback: identify and monitor adherence to infection-prevention practices and requirements; provide prompt, regular feedback on adherence and related outcomes to healthcare personnel and facility leadership; use standardized tools and definitions; monitor infection incidence and act on surveillance data. Core Practices Table > 2. Education and Training: provide job-specific education/training and additional training for recognized lapses.
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
candidate.stem: A hospital audits hand-hygiene opportunities and completed actions, then reports the results to staff. What is the primary purpose?
